mutations.because: The defect this lane fixes, restored: if createJob does not persist the minted handle to storage, the handle only exists in the local process and any other process fails to resolve it (404 / lost). Re-anchored 2026-09-26 by PT-6b1: enqueueJob also writes an entry; anchor narrowed to acquireJob's running entry.
If getStoredJob fails to read from filesystem storage, handles minted out-of-process return undefined and the client encounters a manufactured 404 / lost error.

Eviction must drop settled jobs before running ones; disabling the settled check causes running jobs to be prematurely evicted. Re-anchored 2026-09-26 by PT-6b1: settled check excludes queued rows as well as running ones.
Acquiring a job must refuse concurrent runs for the same campaign with 409; bypassing this check allows duplicate runs to be started.

When recording a job failure fails due to a storage error, the dangling job must be deleted so the campaign is not blocked forever. Re-anchored 2026-09-24 by PT-0b2: the calls it quotes now take the tenant (D167); the mutation is unchanged in meaning. Re-anchored 2026-09-24 in PT-0b2 review: helpers and the run take a StorageScope (a tenant or the run's captured environment); the mutation is unchanged in meaning.
createJob must evict jobs in a loop while stored count meets or exceeds MAX_JOBS to prevent retention from exceeding its cap.
